name: Unidentified water world
description: An inhabited water world existed in the galaxy. In 382 BBY, the EX droid EX-8C saw the world, with artificial lights illuminating its inhabited areas, on its journey from the Outer Rim planet Gloam while carrying a distress message from stranded Jedi Master Rok Buran.
